# github-profile-kit

> Animated, living GitHub profile README generated from one profile.toml by a dependency-free Python 3.11 CLI and a GitHub Action.

- [Agent procedure (SKILL.md)](skills/github-profile/SKILL.md): end-to-end steps to create or update a profile, including consent rules
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): repository rules for coding agents
- [Config schema](profilekit/schema.json): every key, allowed value and length limit
- [Example config](profilekit/example.toml): all features switched on
- CLI: `python3 -m profilekit [--json] init|validate|build|preview|schema|doctor`
- [Config reference](docs/reference-config.md): every key as tables, generated from the schema
- [CLI reference](docs/reference-cli.md): commands, options, JSON output, exit codes
- [Workflow reference](docs/reference-workflows.md): what runs when, permissions, branches
- [Tutorial](docs/tutorial-your-first-profile.md) · [Docs index](docs/README.md)
